description: Config file for the Slot Machine Math Simulator. Describes a slot machine's math model ('slots_info') and, optionally, how to batch-test it ('test_info').

test_info.description: Information related to testing (spin count, wager). If omitted, the machine is still parsed, but is not tested.

test_spins.description: How many spins to run. A single integer runs that many spins and prints one report at the end. An array of integers runs the spins in cumulative stages, printing a report at each checkpoint.

bet.description:
The flat wager staked on every spin, used to compute RTP/volatility figures.

Defaults to 1.

slots_info.description: The configuration of the slotmachine itself, including symbols, patterns, payouts, and virtual reels.

payout_rows.description: The number of rows visible on-screen per spin on each reel.

seed.description:
The RNG seed used to spin the reels. Can either be an integer or 'auto'. 'Auto' seeds from hardware randomness.

Defaults to 'auto'.

symbols.description: Every symbol usable on the reels, referenced elsewhere by 'id'.

type.description:
'normal' behaves as an ordinary symbol.
'wild' substitutes for any other symbol when a paytable/variant checks for a match.

Defaults to 'normal' if omitted.

multiplier.description:
Multiplies the payout of any winning line this symbol takes part in. When a line wins, the multipliers of every symbol on that line are multiplied together and applied to the payout.

Defaults to 1.

reels.description: One entry per physical reel, ordered left to right.

items.description: One reel's physical strip, defined stop-by-stop in strip order.

anyOf.description: A physical stop (or run of stops) of one symbol.

id.description: The symbol id placed at this stop (must be defined in 'symbols').

repeat.description:
How many consecutive physical stops of this symbol to add to the strip, each carring 'weight' virtual stops.

Defaults to 1.

weight.description:
The number of virtual stops assigned to each physical stop of this symbol, controlling how often it's landed on relative to other stops on the same reel.

Defaults to 1.

anyOf.description:
The symbol id placed at this stop (must be defined in 'symbols').

'weight' and 'repeat' defaults to 1.

patterns.description: Defines the subsets of symbols, on the visible screen, evaluated each spin.

id.description: The pattern's unique name, referenced by paytables via 'pattern_id'.

match_type.description:
The type of pattern.
'line' is a single straight line of symbols.

lineType.description:
The line's orientation.
'row': one horizontal line across every reel at a given visible row.
'col': a single reel's own visible rows read top-to-bottom.
'diagonal': a line stepping down-and-right by one row per reel, starting from the given position.
'diagonalReversed': a line stepping down-and-left by one row per reel.

index.description:
The 0-based line index/indices to evaluate: which row(s), reel column(s), or diagonal starting offset(s), depending on 'lineType'. Accepts a single integer or an array of integers, each producing its own separate convolution.

If omitted, every valid line of that orientation is used.

paytables.description:
Scoring rules attached to patterns.
Each spin, every paytable evaluates every line its pattern produced and sums the payouts into that spin's total win/consolation amounts.

id.description: The paytable's unique name, used only for reporting.

pattern_id.description: The patterns id whose convolution(s) this paytable scores (must be defined in 'patterns').

symbol_requirement.description:
The scoring scheme. 
'matching' scores a win when every symbol on it is identical. An all-wild line always counts as a match.

payoutWin.description:
Flat credits paid when a line matches, when 'variants' is not set.
If 'variants' is set, this property will be ignored.

payoutFail.description:
Flat consolation credits paid when a line does NOT match.
If 'variants' is set, this property will be ignored.

Defaults to 0.

variants.description: An optional list of per-symbol payout rules, evaluated in order. For an all-wild line (no base symbol), only a variant explicitly listing the symbol id 'WILD' can match it.

symbols.description: The symbol ids this variant applies to. An empty or omitted array is a catch-all matching any base symbol not claimed by an earlier variant.

withWilds.description:
If 'true', WILD symbols may substitute for requested symbols when checking for a line match.

Defaults to true.

payoutWin.description:
Credits paid when this variant's line matches.

Defaults to 1.

payoutFail.description:
Consolation credits paid when this variant's line does not match.

Defaults to 0.
